ae2_split_cpu.configuration.title: AE2 Split CPU
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.enable: Master switch. When disabled, crafting CPUs never split and behave like vanilla AE2.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.requir: Require at least one Split Component block inside the CPU multiblock before it may split.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.maxSpl: Maximum number of virtual sub-CPUs per master CPU (not counting the master), 0 disables splitting.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.parall: EQUAL = even share (default); PROPORTIONAL = by job bytes; ALL = everything to the newest job; FIXED = fixed value.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.fixedP: Threads per sub-CPU when parallelScheme = FIXED.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.minPar: Lower bound of threads for any scheme.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.loopCo: Storage bytes provided by one Loop Core. Default 0: it is a gate, not storage; the CPU still needs a real storage unit. Set >0 only if you want a marker-only CPU to form.
ae2_split_cpu.configuration.split.requir: When true, only a CPU containing a Loop Core may execute loop recipes; set false to allow any CPU.
